```yaml
name: Codex Review Notify Code Owner

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
    paths:
      - 'AGENTS.md'
      - '.cursor/**'
      - '.mcp.json'
      - 'docs/ai/**'

permissions:
  pull-requests: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  notify-code-owner:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Identify Code Owner
        id: owner
        run: |
          # Determine the code owner for the changed files
          # This script attempts to find the owner from CODEOWNERS or falls back to PR author
          OWNER=""
          
          # Check if CODEOWNERS exists
          if [ -f .github/CODEOWNERS ]; then
            # Simple heuristic: check if any path matches AGENTS.md or docs/ai
            if grep -q "AGENTS.md\|docs/ai\|.cursor\|.mcp.json" .github/CODEOWNERS; then
              # Extract the first matching owner (simplified logic)
              OWNER=$(grep -E "AGENTS.md|docs/ai|\.cursor|\.mcp.json" .github/CODEOWNERS | head -n 1 | awk '{print $2}')
            fi
          fi

          # Fallback to PR author if no specific owner found
          if [ -z "$OWNER" ]; then
            OWNER="${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login }}"
          fi

          echo "owner=$OWNER" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Check for Version Mismatch
        id: check-version
        run: |
          # Check if AGENTS.md contains the outdated version 16.1.6
          if grep -q "next@16.1.6" AGENTS.md; then
            echo "mismatch=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "message=⚠️ **Version Mismatch Detected**: AGENTS.md still references `next@16.1.6`. Please update to `16.2.1` to align with `docs/ai/rules/general.md` and the current monorepo state." >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "mismatch=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "message=✅ No version mismatch detected." >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Notify Code Owner
        if: steps.check-version.outputs.mismatch == 'true'
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const owner = process.env.CODE_OWNER;
            const message = process.env.CHECK_MESSAGE;
            
            await github.rest.issues.createComment({
              issue_number: context.issue.number,
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              body: `@${owner} ${message}`
            });
        env:
          CODE_OWNER: ${{ steps.owner.outputs.owner }}
          CHECK_MESSAGE: ${{ steps.check-version.outputs.message }}
```
